mental_model_and_insights: The EL19A workflow relies on strict separation between operational WO state (GitHub CONTROL/active_work_orders.md), technical evidence (149-sheet V57 workbook), and hypothesis/XML promotion gates.

Conflating A/B/C evidence levels with VERIFIED / BOUNDED-NEGATIVE(method) / HYPOTHESIS claim types—or treating donor A2L/XML symbol matches as semantic proof—is the primary source of rework in multi-agent reverse engineering.

Keeping exact address boundaries (such as FFFF1DB4.bit5 vs. FFFF860B.bit3, FFFF13F0/FFFF1018 vs. FFFF13EA/FFFF1014, and byte-identical physical ROM placements) prevents false equivalence across subroutines.
blind_spots_and_warnings: Only the V57 workbook and prior session context were inspected here; if GitHub CONTROL/active_work_orders.md changed after blob SHA 0836f878ea48528056cd0b02fc20963748c8ee6c, verify the live GitHub file before dispatching or closing work.

Code-execution capability in this session does not automatically exist in text-only or external worker chats; any script or verification note handed off must state exact input files and tool assumptions.
Do not treat this consolidated JSON/Markdown handoff as an authoritative WO register update or XML calibration release.

cross_agent_handoff_rules.single_file_ease: Keep timeline, guardrails, milestones, and agent_self_notes together in one self-contained JSON payload (with optional Markdown companion) for effortless paste/upload across chats
cross_agent_handoff_rules.append_only_self_notes: Each participating agent appends a new object to agent_self_notes with agent_id, model_or_runtime, timestamp, capability_profile, mental_model_and_insights, and blind_spots_and_warnings; never rewrite another agent's historical entry
cross_agent_handoff_rules.capability_honesty: Explicitly declare whether code execution, binary/LST access, or live repo/OneDrive writes are available so downstream workers do not assume unavailable tools
cross_agent_handoff_rules.non_mutation_boundary: Generating or updating the handoff schema does not alter V57/V56/V55 workbooks, mutate CONTROL/active_work_orders.md, create new WOs, or promote unverified candidates into XML
